0022600122.text: The Dallas Mavericks (1-2, 12th in the West) visit the Miami Heat (0-3, 15th in the East) in the Mavericks' fourth game of the season, with Dallas 2 games back in the Southwest and Miami on a three-game losing streak and 2 games back in the Southeast. Dallas will be without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain; 23.0 points and 24.9 minutes per game this season), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Kyrie Irving is day-to-day with a knee issue and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Mavericks winning the most recent meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
